content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the to-do management page","i_want":"to update an existing task's title and Due Date","so_that":"my task list reflects the current state of my work","business_description":"Users can correct or update an existing task. Updates are saved only after the backend confirms them. The form validates the title and Due Date, and the user sees a success or error message for every update.","business_value":"Keeps task data accurate without deleting and recreating tasks, and ensures the list never shows a change that was not saved.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to a non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title and returns success, and only after that response the task list shows the new title and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"An update request is pending and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The user is waiting after submitting the edit form","then":"No success message is shown and the task list shows the old values for that task"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the stored title is unchanged, and the message 'Title is mandatory' is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating the 100-character limit is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated, shows no success message, keeps the form values for correction, and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no stored data is changed"},{"given":"An update request with a malformed body or a field of the wrong type","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no stored data is changed"},{"given":"An update request where the database fails during the write","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"A successful task update","when":"The backend stores the updated task","then":"The Last Updated Date of the task is set to the time of the update"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is allowed, because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title containing only spaces: the PRD says the title must be non-empty but does not say whether spaces count as content. Open question.","Whether the Creation Date can be edited is not stated in the PRD. This story assumes it cannot be changed. Open question.","Whether a submit with no changed values is saved, or rejected, is not stated in the PRD. Open question.","The exact wording of the error messages other than 'Title is mandatory' is not specified in the PRD. Open question."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["The update endpoint returns success, Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory field, validation and internal server error responses as specified in the acceptance criteria.","The edit form pre-fills the existing values and reuses the create form.","The frontend shows a success or error message after every update and never shows an updated state for a failed request.","The Last Updated Date is set on every successful update.","Automated tests cover every acceptance criterion and pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and error responses","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add the endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. Return Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory field, validation and internal server error responses. Set the Last Updated Date on every successful update. Do not change any other stored data. The Creation Date is not changed.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates title, description, status, priority and Due Date of an existing task by ID.","Empty title, title over 100 characters and Due Date earlier than Creation Date are rejected with a validation error and no change is stored.","Unknown ID returns Task Not Found and malformed or wrongly typed input returns an invalid input error, with no change stored.","Database write failure returns an internal server error and leaves the stored task unchanged.","Last Updated Date is set to the time of each successful update.","Unit tests cover each response path."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task creation form in edit mode. On an error response, keep the form values, do not show the task as updated, and show an error message.
